messages:
Maria (CSM): Heads up — ClearLeaf usage dropped ~70% since we flipped the 2.1 embed rollout yesterday. Their internal advocate (Kira) left last week and procurement pinged asking if we can match a competitor's price. Renewal in 6 weeks. Can we triage risk and surface immediate actions? Dashboard: https://rbw.infer/d/cleaf/activity

Leo (Account Exec): ugh. saw the spike down in the weekly report. Do we know if calls are failing or just lower traffic?

Maria (CSM): It's not errors, it's fewer requests. Their app moved to a batched mode but volume still way below expected. Support convo shows no latency spikes. Kira was handling enablement + prompt templates — they loved the embed quality.

Sam (Solutions Eng): I can pull model invocation logs and compare per-endpoint token counts. Sending quick query now:
```
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) as hr, count(*) as calls, avg(latency_ms) as lat
FROM prod.requests
WHERE account_id = 'acct_cle' AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY hr
ORDER BY hr DESC
LIMIT 48;
```
Will post findings in 15.

Jamie (Sales): If this is churn-risk, we should prepare an offer: extended pilot + 3 months of reserved credits at a modest discount. Also loop legal for expedited SOW if procurement wants terms. @Leo can you confirm flexibility? :thinking_face:

Leo (Account Exec): I can do a one-time pilot extension, yes. Need sign-off from RevOps for credits. I'll ping them.

OpsBot: Reminder — renewal for ClearLeaf (acct_cle) scheduled 2026-05-12. 6 weeks left.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Quick readout: calls/day down 68% after 2026-03-01 (embed switch). Avg latency stable ~82ms. No obvious 5xx spikes. Looks like client-side change (batching + fewer embed calls).

Maria (CSM): That matches feedback — PM said they reworked UI to fetch less frequently. But they stopped calling some user-level features that were main value props. Need to re-engage product team to show ROI.

Jamie (Sales): Proposed next steps: 1) Quick health call with their PM + engineering (this week). 2) Offer 6-week pilot extension + 20% reserved-credit promo. 3) Send short evaluation pack showing cost/perf tradeoffs for more aggressive prefetching.

Maria (CSM): I'll schedule the call and prep the ROI slides. @Sam can you prepare a 1-page perf/cost snapshot and a short checklist for recovery actions (prompt tweaks, cache windows, batch size)?

Sam (Solutions Eng): Yep. I'll include examples and a tiny config diff they can try (batch_size: 8 -> 16, prefetch: true).

Leo (Account Exec): I'll talk to RevOps and Legal. If procurement wants competitor pricing, let's get specifics and a proposed counter.

Maria (CSM): Thanks all. I'll post the calendar invite and attach the slides. If anyone hears anything from procurement before the call, drop it here. :pray:

Jamie (Sales): +1. If they lost their advocate, we should include a short enablement session for new champions — 30m deep-dive.

Maria (CSM): Good call. I'll add enablement to the agenda.

Leo (Account Exec): tagging this as P1 renewal-risk.

Maria (CSM): Closing loop later today with the call time. Appreciate the quick triage.
